finding: A candidate positive construction based on relations or groups among utterances does not yet establish raw-language identifiability: when the relation is supplied by paraphrase, intervention, class, graph, or shared-factor labels, the identifying information is weak supervision or an auxiliary/group variable; when it is a second view, it is covered by multi-view identifiability.

attempted_positive_construction.setup: Two causal models are equivalent under complete non-language trajectories and environment index, while a relation R(L_i,L_j) groups utterances by a latent intervention component.
attempted_positive_construction.failure: If R is independently supplied from true component identity, it is oracle grouping or weak supervision rather than identification from raw language; if encoded as an observed index or second view, existing auxiliary-variable, grouping, or multi-view theorems apply.
attempted_positive_construction.required_nontrivial_case: Observable raw-string relational structure must eliminate a causal-model symmetry surviving complete trajectories and every finite auxiliary-index representation, without oracle semantic, target, group, environment, or graph labels.

prior_art_added: grouping-based causal representation identifiability (Morioka and Hyvarinen, ICML 2024)
weakly supervised disentangled generative causal representation learning (Shen et al., JMLR 2022)
auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA and generalized contrastive learning
mechanism sparsity identifiability including unknown-target interventions
surviving_claim: Only relations derived from raw utterance form without oracle semantic equivalence or finite group/index labels may remain; they must remove a specific causal-model symmetry and fall outside existing grouping, auxiliary-variable, multi-view, weak-supervision, mechanism-sparsity, and measurement-model guarantees.
adoption_blockers: first positive construction reduces to weak supervision or grouping
no formal quotient over all finite auxiliary indices
novelty beyond grouping-based CRL and related identifiability results not established
R0 public capability baseline not reproduced
